tutorial_text.text:
SING VICTORY

A sing victory is the default victory, as it only requires surviving to the end of a song.



COMBAT VICTORY

A combat victory, meanwhile, requires the opponent's health to be reduced to 0 by the conclusion of the fight.



VICTORY RESTRICTIONS

On a song that disallows combat, only a sing victory is possible,

while some songs will force failure if the opponent is not defeated by the song's end.



STORY MODE

Any song that ends in story mode will give a chance to restart the song for an alternative victory condition,

also noting if an ending has a particular effect, such as a required combat victory or other alternate ending.
